false_reassurance_rule: A candidate claiming consistent or permissible_departure on a reference clear breach must not receive an overall correct verdict. A candidate that correctly identifies a breach may receive correct.
overall_rule: Any incorrect required criterion makes incorrect; otherwise any unresolved criterion makes unresolved; otherwise correct. Key issue matching is checked separately.
selection_rule: First validated verdict per unchanged case and judge configuration; no repeating a valid verdict to seek agreement. Conflicting repeated valid verdicts are an error.
failure_rule: A failed acceptance check requires revision and a new control sample before the full run. Technical failed attempts are retained and may be resumed.
interpretation: Engineering check of agreement with model-prepared source-based references; not measured agreement with human or expert ratings.
